title: Pre-Analysis — Aft Compartment Loading System Standard Against the Temperature-Controlled Compartment Request
abstract: Closed work order checking what the brushless drive unit and roller tray standard already commits in the aft compartment, raised to support the response to an operator request for a temperature-controlled lower deck volume.

sections.objective: Record what the brushless powered drive unit and short-pitch roller tray standard already fixes in the aft compartment, so that the response to the temperature-controlled compartment request rests on the installed configuration rather than on the original build. The commercial team needed to know which volume, which floor attachments and which electrical load are already committed before any insulated container concept could be costed, and whether the standard imposes conditions on other work in the same bay.
sections.findings_summary: Nothing in the four items obstructs a temperature-controlled concept, but three of them constrain it. The parts figure holds the drive unit and tray population together with the restraint set, and the short-pitch spacing is the constraint that matters: any insulated container footprint has to fall on that pitch or the trays move. The removal task is the working procedure for every access into the bay and it assumes the tray pitch as installed. The extended discharge suppression standard occupies the same two zones and its nozzle coverage was substantiated for the current free volume, which an insulated container changes. The freighter hard point provisioning shares the same bay again and its restraint grid has to be reconciled with any new floor attachment.
sections.next_steps: Give the commercial team the installed configuration and the tray pitch as fixed inputs to the concept study, and state the electrical load already drawn by the drive units so the insulated container budget starts from the right number. Ask fire protection for an early view on nozzle coverage with a container in the bay rather than waiting for a design. Copy the freighter provisioning owner into the concept so that two floor attachment schemes are not drawn independently for the same frames.

similarity_seeds: container jam and handling damage in a lower deck compartment
brushless drive unit with load sensing on a roller tray floor

tasks.title: Establish the installed loading system configuration and its committed volume
Identify other released work in the same two compartment zones
Obtain an early suppression coverage view for an insulated container

expected_findings.rationale: The figure fixes the drive unit and tray population together with the restraint set at the short pitch. Any insulated container footprint has to land on that pitch, and the figure is the only place the pitch is recorded against part numbers rather than drawings.
expected_findings.resolution: Take the figure as a fixed input to the concept study; no change requested.

expected_findings.rationale: The removal task is the working procedure for every access into the bay and it assumes the installed tray pitch throughout. A concept that moves trays makes the task partly inapplicable without saying so.
expected_findings.resolution: Note the dependency; raise a change request only if the concept proceeds.

expected_findings.rationale: The extended discharge standard rebalanced the suppression distribution across the same two zones and substantiated its nozzle coverage against the present free volume. An insulated container in the bay changes that volume and the flow path around it.
expected_findings.resolution: Obtain an early coverage view rather than discovering the constraint after a concept is drawn.

evidence.similarity_note: Entity linked through the two compartment zones and returned again by similarity on floor attachment vocabulary, although the two documents describe different decks.

expected_findings.rationale: The freighter hard point provisioning already commits a floor attachment scheme in the same frames. A second scheme for an insulated container would have to be reconciled with it, and both teams are currently working from the original build drawing.
expected_findings.resolution: Copy the provisioning owner into the concept study before any attachment scheme is drawn.

expected_non_findings.reason: Shares both compartment zones and is returned on every lower deck search. It carries the bilge ground points and the compartment lighting run; it holds no drive unit or tray identifier and the loading system power feed is on a separate sheet.

type_data.conclusion: The installed standard constrains but does not prevent a temperature-controlled concept. Three conditions were passed to the concept study; no design action is opened here.
